To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the performance of pig farms can be increased by the application of the following factors: (1) the use of a modern management strategy (2) the use of the most modern piglet rearing technologies (3) the use of modern breeding technologies (4) the use of veterinary services (5) the use of good construction technology and building engineering characteristics.
veterinary management, in addition to the management strategy and the technology used in pig breeding, has a significant effect on performance, which is defined in a wide sense.
the management strategy and the veterinary practice management have significant effect on the performance of a pig breeding farm.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of an integrated, complex model for pig breeding farms, based on the principles of management science, with a special emphasis on veterinary management.

a quantitative, statistically based approach for evaluating the role of veterinary management in the performance of pig production farms, which may also be applied in other branches of veterinary medicine.
the identification of the factors influencing the performance of pig farms, and the quantification of the effects of these factors on performance.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
veterinary management is a key factor in the economic success of pig breeding farms.
veterinary management has an important role in the performance of pig farms, and the effect can be quantified.
veterinary management has a significant effect on the performance of farms, and the economic importance of this is considerable.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

veterinary management, as an independent variable, has a significant, direct effect on the performance of farms, and this effect is not only indirect, mediated through the effect of other factors of production, but is also direct.
the effect of the management strategy and the veterinary practice management on the performance of farms are significant.

the management strategy, the veterinary practice management, the building conditions and the breeding technology of farms have a statistically significant effect on the economic efficiency of the farms.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a significant part of the variance of performance can be explained by the independent variables.
veterinary management has a significant impact on pig production performance.
veterinary management is an important factor in increasing the efficiency of breeding.
